key_insight: PP-VarQITE designs shallow thermal-state preparation circuits entirely classically, encoding temperature in the angles of a fixed circuit architecture.
engineering_relevance: Shallower circuits reduce quantum hardware depth requirements, enabling low-temperature state preparation beyond the practical reach of statevector simulation.
method: Combine Pauli propagation with variational quantum imaginary-time evolution.
Vary circuit angles to target different temperatures without changing the architecture.
evidence_signal: Numerical studies reached 100 qubits with approximately 2–10× shallower circuits than the lowest-depth sequential tensor-network compilations; Quantinuum Helios demonstrations used 96 and 98 qubits, with the 7×7 Ising lattice requiring at most 42 two-qubit layers.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated for selected Ising and frustrated Heisenberg models; classical optimization cost and accuracy for broader Hamiltonians require further evaluation.
paper_title: Thermal state preparation with shallow quantum circuits
